label: AUDIT BIZ — sintetis, read-only source; mutation hanya pada svara_audit_docs

probes.requirement: PRD §1.2 / README: public survey policy and notice come from the survey scope (organizations or platform_profile), no SMK fallback
probes.expected: detail.profile.source=platform; public profile/notice equals platform_profile; guardian not forced by legacy profiles row

probes.requirement: PRD §1.2: organization-scope survey uses organizations row; notice_version reflects the same source
probes.expected: public profile is org_perpus (adult/self), notice matches org source/version
probes.evidence: runtime API; surveys.profile_id remains legacy p_smk while organization_id=org_perpus

probes.requirement: PRD §5.3/AC04/R8: close stops new submissions for the survey version; latest published version is the active form
probes.expected: after publishing v2 then closing, no published version remains, link v2 closed, submit 409
probes.evidence: server/routes/surveys.ts:480-483 (publish does not close old), 518-529 (close only first published), 558-563 (invitations pick first published), public.ts:219-224 (survey status closed ignored)

probes.requirement: PRD §6/§9.1, invariant 5/13, AC12: consent belongs to its context; another context cannot reuse it
probes.expected: invitation submission rejects consent recorded for the public link
probes.evidence: server/routes/public.ts:385-398 (checks survey+version only), consent insert line 470 stores invitation_id but requireConsent ignores it

probes.requirement: Invariant 5: another context cannot retrieve the receipt
probes.expected: 404 when retrieving an invitation response receipt through the public link context

probes.requirement: PRD §9.1 / README: petugas ber-grant can open assigned survey and results; UI and API enforce the same permission
probes.expected: granted survey appears in bootstrap so UI can render it; summary allowed by grant 111
probes.evidence: server/http.ts:122-144 excludes grant-only surveys for role creator; src/screens/CreatorData.tsx uses findSurvey from hydrated bootstrap

probes.requirement: PRD §1.2/§9, README: org_admin manages org surveys and may read full results for them
probes.expected: org_admin gets org survey, share data, and full results; UI exposes management
probes.evidence: bootstrap manageableSurveyIds owner-only; src/screens/CreatorData.tsx:64,90 isOwner; CreatorCore.tsx:61,230,401 owner-only

probes.requirement: PRD §9.1/README: individual, export, free-text are separate permissions; survey_settings gate grant reads
probes.expected: policy must state whether export ignores allow_individual/allow_results; current doc is silent/ambiguous
probes.evidence: server/http.ts:176-179 canExport ignores settings; README gate claim covers only can_read_individual/aggregate

probes.requirement: PRD §9.2/AC12: privacy/notice/contact come from deployment profile (organization/platform), synthetic status clear
probes.expected: policy endpoint reflects organizations/platform_profile and scope; no legacy profiles-only source
probes.evidence: server/routes/public.ts:681-697 selects profiles/notices only; src/app/privacy/page.tsx uses static sections

probes.requirement: PRD §9.2/AC12: withdrawal/deletion request recorded and fulfilled under verified identity
probes.expected: request references a subject/response/consent and enforcement is traceable, or explicitly documented as manual
probes.evidence: 001_initial.sql data_requests has no survey/response/consent subject key; admin PATCH only updates status/note
